verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a multilingual model (flux-general-multi) covering 10 languages with in-conversation language switching. This implies the service handles the spoken language without a fixed per-request declaration, but the evidence never explicitly describes an automatic language-detection feature. Missing for 10: an explicit language-detection parameter or feature, the detected language returned in the response, detection beyond the 10-language multilingual model, coverage for pre-recorded versus streaming audio, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
